reviews.text: A simple operation like spaying my dog ​​resulted in them leaving her with an entire ovary, and now she needs another operation. Of course, at a different vet because I don't trust them. Disappointing.

I've had the opportunity to have two of my dogs treated there...gentleness, attention, very good treatment, humility...for me they are a 10 out of 10 and I am always very grateful for the treatment received towards my little ones and towards me...thank you.
You have no idea about exotic animals.
I don't like how you work with wild animals. You have no idea.

They are experienced veterinarians, very good, and their prices are very reasonable. They are very considerate, doing what's necessary without taking advantage of the situation to make money. Highly recommended!

I've had the best experience of my life with them. They are incredibly kind, dedicated, and loving with the dogs. I had a problem with a dog that was sold to me sick, and despite my desperation, they treated me exceptionally well, even though it was my first time there. They helped and guided me through everything that happened, explaining things clearly and directly about how the disease works, incubation periods, and so on.

The best part is that they support me if needed, and Maria Dolores has even offered to go wherever necessary to explain the disease. What more can I say about these people? They give me the impression that they've given their all for animals, and for me, that's the most important thing.
They treated my cats with love and care. I have no complaints.
A wonderful clinic with a big heart for our furry friends. And Susana and Dolores are excellent professionals.

The first time I went, my dog ​​got fleas due to poor hygiene. The second time, I took her for fleas and because she had a wound, and they made her sick. The third time, I went to get her treated for the illness, but they prescribed things that made her worse. I decided to take her to a different clinic, and they told me that what they had prescribed had made her worse. They also said they needed to remove the hair from the wound, but they didn't. Now my dog ​​is recovering, but I don't plan to go back because I paid 100 euros only to have them make my dog ​​sick.
Wonderful and very kind, perfect service
